claims.v02_claim: A cross-domain semantic-power composition model in which stronger meaning requires an explicit typed transition.
pressure_reason: Noninterference and information-flow control already formalize that composition must not create disallowed information power.
Proof-carrying authorization and policy-composition calculi already require stronger authorization effects to follow explicit proof/policy semantics rather than implicit composition.
Provenance semirings show that heterogeneous provenance annotations can have a formal composition algebra.
claims.engineering_value: Matawaka can still provide a useful domain-specific semantic-escalation taxonomy, integration profile and adversarial conformance corpus that composes established ideas across AI governance surfaces.
forbidden_claims: Semantic non-escalation is a foundational logic invented by Matawaka.
Matawaka first formalized safe composition without privilege or meaning amplification.
Cross-layer non-promotion is novel merely because Matawaka applies it to AI evidence.
required_next_evidence: Stop treating SNE-HEC itself as a novelty claim and instead define a measurable semantic-escalation fault taxonomy.
Compare a new benchmark/evaluation method against security-policy interference, IFC and authorization-logic test methodologies.
Show empirical defects in contemporary AI systems that the integrated Matawaka profile catches more systematically than existing isolated mechanisms.

claims.v02_claim: A shared receipt envelope where machine-readable non_effects constrain heterogeneous cross-receipt composition.
pressure_reason: Effect systems make possible side effects first-class machine-checkable semantics and distinguish them from returned values.
Frame/local reasoning makes preserved or untouched state part of formal correctness reasoning.
The particular field name non_effects and its receipt placement are representational choices rather than new foundational semantics.
claims.engineering_value: A uniform `non_effects` field can remain a strong protocol-design convention for preventing verifier/UI overclaims across heterogeneous receipts, even though the underlying semantic idea is old.
forbidden_claims: Machine-readable negative effects or preserved-state contracts were invented by Matawaka.
A common non_effects field is a new foundational semantic primitive.
Explicit negative receipt semantics have no meaningful pre-AI predecessors.
required_next_evidence: Evaluate whether a standardized negative-semantics envelope improves interoperability and human interpretation across independent evidence systems.
Treat `non_effects` as a protocol profile/engineering contribution unless a genuinely new formal composition property is demonstrated.

claims.v02_claim: Heterogeneous resource-level exists != available != considered/relied upon != authority != responsibility.
pressure_reason: Awareness was formally separated from belief by 1987, and awareness sets were explicitly partitioned into consideration and non-consideration sets by 1995.
Intention and action were separately formalized by 1990; BOID separated beliefs, obligations, intentions and desires before action commitment.
W3C PROV separately represents plan reliance, agent responsibility and delegation of authority/responsibility.
claims.surviving_claim: A machine-auditable protocol profile that represents heterogeneous intelligence resources with provenance and independently records existence, decision-specific availability, actual consideration/reliance, decision authority and responsibility without treating epistemic access as governance power.
claims.engineering_value: PoAI can contribute an operational schema, evidence discipline and verification surface that unifies previously separate decision-science, epistemic and provenance relations for AI-augmented decisions.
forbidden_claims: PoAI invented the separation of epistemic state from intention, obligation or responsibility.
The conceptual chain exists/available/considered/authority is foundationally new as individual distinctions.
required_next_evidence: Search pre-2025 decision-provenance and knowledge-management systems for one machine record already combining provenance, availability, consideration/reliance and authority/responsibility.
Define falsifiable semantics for availability and consideration rather than relying on self-declared UI fields.
Demonstrate independent implementations in materially different decision domains.

claims.v02_claim: The exact semantic necessity of State/Evidence -> Availability -> Intent -> Authority/Responsibility -> Coordination -> Action -> Outcome/Successor as non-implicit transitions.
pressure_reason: Agent theory already separates epistemic/goal/intention/action concepts and deontic components.
Authorization systems already require explicit proofs/policies before protected actions.
W3C PROV already links agents, intended plans, responsibility, delegated authority, activities and outcomes in a domain-neutral provenance model.
in-toto already verifies an expected authorized multi-step action/artifact chain against signed observed execution metadata.
claims.engineering_value: The seven-layer stack can remain a coherent minimal engineering profile for Matawaka, but its exact labels/order are an architectural synthesis rather than evidence of a new foundational logic.
forbidden_claims: The seven-layer sequence is a foundationally novel agent architecture.
Matawaka first linked evidence, intention, authority, responsibility, action and outcome as explicit types.
A unique ordering or set of seven names establishes novelty.
required_next_evidence: Reframe the seven layers as a profile justified by failure analysis and implementation utility rather than novelty.
Provide ablation experiments showing which real AI-governance failures appear when layers are collapsed.
Compare conformance cost and safety benefit against alternative decompositions including SOOS, PROV-based profiles and authorization/effect systems.

claims.v02_claim: One semantic contract reused across accountable human-AI authorship/decision governance and externally consequential agent action.
pressure_reason: OPM and W3C PROV are explicitly technology/domain-neutral and represent provenance for digital, physical or conceptual things, human/software/organizational agents, activities, plans, responsibility and delegation.
in-toto demonstrates that a provenance abstraction can bind authorized actors, expected action steps and observed artifacts.
Therefore cross-domain abstraction itself is not a novelty claim.
claims.surviving_claim: A concrete interoperable profile that combines decision epistemics, responsibility/authority governance and pre-/post-action evidence under one contract and demonstrates unchanged semantics in both human-AI intellectual-work provenance and autonomous external-action use cases.
claims.engineering_value: The contribution may be demonstrating a practical bridge between accountability domains that older general provenance models leave policy-neutral, especially by adding fail-closed action admission and decision-time intelligence evidence.
forbidden_claims: Matawaka invented domain-neutral provenance or cross-domain agent/activity modeling.
No prior model spans human and software agents, plans, responsibility, delegation and artifacts.
Using one schema in two Matawaka applications proves foundational cross-domain novelty.
required_next_evidence: Search provenance profiles, workflow languages, scientific provenance, legal/audit records and policy-as-code for predecessors that combine descriptive provenance with pre-action authority and decision epistemics.
Demonstrate exact semantic reuse across independent external consumers, not only Matawaka-authored examples.
Measure what additional guarantees the Matawaka profile supplies beyond W3C PROV plus a conventional authorization mechanism.
